payload.summary: Adversarial real-PDF and table-fact regressions are reviewed and tested; broader acceptance remains
payload.detail:
CURRENT EXECUTION 24 October 2026: The new synthetic real-PDF four-column fixture covers wrapped actions, confirmed vertical group merge, group termination and distinct threshold/rate/action tuples. A separate producer regression preserves those relationships and source provenance. Both executed with PyMuPDF available; ingestion specialist review is clear. Keep the integration limit explicit: the extractor and producer use complementary fixtures; the complete imageTableMetadata handoff and broader benchmark acceptance are not demonstrated. Parser behavior was unchanged and no re-index was run.

HISTORICAL DETAIL (superseded where corrected above): LOCAL PROOF 24 October 2026: a new synthetic real-PDF test exercises four columns, wrapped actions, a confirmed vertically merged group, different threshold/rate/action tuples and the next unmerged group. tests/relational-table-evidence.test.ts invokes that Python test when PyMuPDF exists and separately asserts table-fact tuples and provenance. Existing parser was unchanged. Focused table producer/grouping/ranking/PDF tests passed; new real-PDF regression passed. Remaining: independent review and deciding whether this plus the existing reading-order fixtures covers the intended broader adversarial table benchmark. No live corpus, re-index or extraction-behaviour change is claimed.
